messages:
liz_marketing: Quick sync — we need a tight battle-ready playbook for the April webinar + launch posts. Focus: benchmarking narrative vs Cloud AI endpoints, LLM APIs, and infra vendors. Who can pull the final claims?
raj_sales: I can consolidate top objections from SDRs. Main asks: pricing predictability, SLA, and fallback behavior.
ben_research: I have the draft benchmark numbers (tail latency, p95 cost/token, and cold-start comparison). Will post a snapshot in a sec.
ben_research: p95 latency (chat flow, 512 tokens): Redwood-hosted v2: 85ms; CloudX-managed endpoint: 210ms; Self-hosted infra stack: 120-180ms depending on config. Cost/token (normalized): Redwood 0.6x, CloudX 1.0x, Self-hosted 0.9x (w/o infra amortization).
liz_marketing: Perfect. We should avoid hard claims in outbound posts — phrasing needs to be "based on internal benchmark" and link to methodology. Add a one-liner: "Consistent latency at scale, predictable spend."
nora_product: Recommend three framing bullets for the battlecard: 1) Predictable economics (batching + reserved capacity); 2) Degradation strategy (routing + variant fallbacks); 3) Dev DX (same API across hosted/dedicated/private).
raj_sales: For SDRs: give two quick rebuttals per competitor. Example: CloudX customers cite "too slow at scale" — rebuttal: "Our continuous batching + prefix caching keeps tail latency flat under load."
eva_growth: I'll craft the webinar registration copy: highlight a live demo showing a 5k-rps sustained run and the cost delta. Need a one-line hook. Draft: "How to run LLM features with predictable latency and half the token cost — live."
sam_ops: For the technical slide — include a tiny diagram + a sample routing policy snippet. Copy for slide: ```routing: - prioritize: latency - fallback: cheaper-quantized - region: nearest```
ben_research: Methodology note to include in appendix: synthetic chat workload, mixed prompt lengths 32/128/512, 95th percentile over 30-minute steady state, 3 runs each. Raw CSV hosted on drive.
liz_marketing: Good — legal flagged the word "half" in cost delta. Use "up to 50% lower" and add a footnote.
raj_sales: SDR routing play: inbound -> qualification form -> auto-route to dedicated trials (if company size > $50M ARR) else hosted free-credit flow. Need a short Slack snippet for the playbook.
nora_product: Add escalation rule: if trial hits >90th percentile latency or error-rate >2% -> auto-notify eng-oncall + fallback to compat model. Example message: `@eng-oncall routing: trial-123 exceeded latency threshold, switching to compat-v1`
eva_growth: For the launch post we should pair the benchmark with a customer quote. Any volunteers to reach out?
raj_sales: I'll ask two pilot customers for a one-liner.
ben_research: Also include caveats: different model families, sequence lengths, and tokenization behavior can change absolute numbers. Emphasize relative movement and operational controls.
liz_marketing: Ok action items: 1) Ben — finalize benchmark CSV + methodology link by EOD tomorrow. 2) Nora — craft the battlecard bullets + SDR one-pager by Wed. 3) Raj — get customer quotes and SDR rebut snippets by Thurs. 4) Eva — draft webinar signup + launch post w/ toned-down language by Fri. 5) Sam — slide + routing snippet for demo infra.
inc-bot: Reminder: Webinar slot reserved Apr 15 11:00 PDT. Event page: https://go.redwood.ai/webinar-apr15 :calendar: 
liz_marketing: Thanks — small ask: make the SDR one-pager copy no longer than 6 bullets and include suggested slack snippets. Keep language non-technical for sales.
raj_sales: Will do. Quick sample slack snippet for reps: "If prospect asks about outages: 'We build in model variants + cross-region fallback so your app stays responsive even during node failures.'"
ben_research: I'll add the benchmark methodology to the drive and ping the doc link here when ready.
eva_growth: I'll put an early draft of the launch post in Google Docs and share for quick review.
liz_marketing: Awesome — let's reconvene Thurs 10am to review final battlecard and the webinar flow. :thumbsup:
